comment: mkroom.c rest_rooms() (893-906), which restore.c getlev() calls, with save.c savelev():564 zeroing svr.rooms[]. A gnomish Healer in debug mode level-teleports to the Oracle (Dlvl 8 for this seed, found with #wizwhere), teleports onto a Delphi fountain and runs #overview, which marks the Delphi subroom seen. #wizloadlua minefill then runs mkmap.c join_map_cleanup(), which sets svn.nroom and gn.nsubroom to 0 but leaves the old room records in memory, and the hero saves. After the restore only svn.nroom rooms come back and the rest of svr.rooms[] is zero, so the second segment's #overview finds no Delphi room and prints no 'Oracle of Delphi.' line. Seeds, datetimes, character and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session.
